description: Changes an app's general settings; the rest are in neblla_update_app_<module> (rooms, community, payments, auth, storage, games, business, inbox, integrations), the slug in neblla_set_slug. All wait for neblla_promote "save" except turnstile, cloudFolder, example and verifyDomain, which act at once. More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app

addDomain.description: An origin (https://site.com) allowed to use the backend, added to the list; "*.site.com" allows one subdomain level.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

cloudFolder.description: Folder of the app's files in users' Dropbox / Drive; unique, locked once used.

compiled.description: true or capacitor, tauri, electron: lets a packaged app reach the backend from its own origin.

customDomain.description: Your domain, where Neblla will serve the app; the answer gives the CNAME to set; null removes it.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

erasureWindow.description: false: the app handles users' erasure requests itself (default true: Neblla's window).

example.description: true marks the app as an example: its code goes to a public GitHub repo, the slug gets -example and it sells in Stripe test mode; false removes it.

features.description: Modules on or off, e.g. { shop: true }; only those passed change, dependencies follow.

keepFogCases.description: BYODB only: true keeps Fog cases until you delete them (default: deleted after 30 days).

keys.description: Public values the app reads with neblla.api.key(name), merged; null removes one. Never secrets.

moderationLog.description: true logs every moderation act (costs quota).

playerQuota.description: Most one user may spend of the app's daily quota, in % (default 20; 0 = no cap; null = default).

playerStats.description: true keeps each player's first visit, last visit and visit count (costs quota).

removeDomain.description: The entry to remove, exactly as listed.

theme.description: { palette, typography, layout }; stored only, files unchanged (neblla_retheme_app rewrites them); null removes it.

turnstile.description: Bot check before a new guest is created: true (Neblla's widget), { siteKey, secretKey } (yours), false / null (off).

verifyDomain.description: A listed domain to prove as yours; the answer says the TXT record or file to put.

name: neblla_update_app
title: Change an app's general settings
